M-OP-PLAY.Purpose: The manual play operation: stage the composition, build, and run the game with GUI passthrough in the same container as test runs — no scenarios, no verdict.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Scripts/play: --profile local|ci, --vm, --stop CONTAINER; the flow is the shared game_pipeline minus the verdict plane, declared inline in the command file.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: GUI backend detection and container mechanics — owned by M-GAME.

Requirements.REQ-001: Play runs the same container configuration as test runs; only the entrypoint and mounts differ.
Requirements.REQ-002: Play never writes report.json or diff.json: Player.log in the run directory is the only evidence.
Requirements.REQ-003: Exit code is always 0: play has no verdict plane.
